response.title: which solar generator can back up a whole house and how many do i need
response.answer:
Yes, a solar generator can back up an entire house, including refrigerators, lights, internet, air conditioning, and potentially even a 240V well pump or electric appliances.

However, most portable solar generators cannot power an entire house by themselves. You'll need either a large expandable system or multiple units connected in a manufacturer-approved configuration.

The number you need depends on two things:

Power (kW): How many appliances can run simultaneously.

Battery capacity (kWh): How many hours or days your house can run during an outage.

For a typical American house, I would look at systems with at least 10–15 kW of output and 20–40 kWh of battery storage if you want substantial whole-house backup rather than just essential appliances.
